API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APILog Streaming Service (LSS) ConfigurationGets all LSS log formats for the specified customer.
Gets all LSS log formats for the specified customer.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/:customerId/lssConfig/logType/formats

Gets all LSS log formats for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
logType
string

Supported Log type values are: zpn_trans_log, zpn_auth_log, zpn_ast_auth_log, zpn_http_trans_log, zpn_audit_log, zpn_sys_auth_log, zpn_ast_comprehensive_stats, zpn_waf_http_exchanges_log, zpn_smb_inspection_log, zpn_ldap_inspection_log, zpn_krb_inspection_log, zpn_pbroker_comprehensive_stats, zpn_sitec_auth_log, zpn_sitec_comprehensive_stats, zms_flow_log
